verdict.rationale: OneDrive documents external sharing with partners and clients, sharing links on items via createLink, and folder hierarchies addressable by path, which covers the basic shared-folder structure of a data room. The evidence never documents view-only link types, download blocking, or per-viewer access visibility; the only nearby mention is a generic reference to file 'analytics'. Missing for 10: documented view-only/read-only link scope, download-prevention controls, access logs or viewer visibility for diligence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-room use.
